description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeePictureDao, a data access object responsible for CRUD operations related to employee pictures within the OrangeHRM project. It includes test methods for saving employee pictures and retrieving pictures by employee number, utilizing mock data and setup routines.

classes.name: EmployeePictureDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeePictureDao methods, including saving and retrieving employee pictures.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmployeePictureDao, and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Tests the saveEmployeePicture method of EmployeePictureDao, verifying the save/update functionality of employee pictures.

methods.name: testGetEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee pictures by employee number, ensuring correct fetch and null cases.
